games.headline: Alexander-Walker’s 28 points lead Hawks past Wizards; Young scores 23 in return to Atlanta
games.desc: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 28 points and the Atlanta Hawks held off the Washington Wizards 139-132 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Jayson Tatum scores 34 as Celtics demolish the Hornets 119-80 in NBA Cup play
games.desc: — Jayson Tatum had 34 points, nine assists and eight rebounds, Derrick White added 18 points and the Boston Celtics demolished the Charlotte Hornets 119-80 on Friday night for their seventh win in eight games.

games.headline: Cavaliers beat 76ers 119-95 as LeBron James is held to 8 points in return to Cleveland
games.desc: — Donovan Mitchell scored 23 points as the Cleveland Cavaliers held LeBron James to eight points in his return to Northeast Ohio and rolled to a 119-95 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers in an NBA Cup group stage game Friday night.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg and Kyrie Irving rebound from sluggish 1st half to help Mavs beat Jazz 112-100
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg scored 21 points and Kyrie Irving added 14 after a sluggish first half for both stars as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Utah Jazz 112-100 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Ajay Mitchell scores a career-high 35 points as Thunder rout Grizzlies 128-97
games.desc: — Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 35 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Memphis Grizzlies 128-97 on Friday night in an NBA Cup group stage game.

games.headline: Alijah Martin's career game helps short-handed Raptors beat the Bucks 121-107 in NBA Cup game
games.desc: — Alijah Martin scored a career-high 27 points and RJ Barrett also had 27 as the short-handed Toronto Raptors defeated the Milwaukee Bucks 121-107 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.

games.headline: Ayo Dosunmu scores 26 points as Timberwolves top Pelicans to stay unbeaten in NBA Cup play
games.desc: — Ayo Dosunmu scored 26 points in the Timberwolves 115-109 victory over the Pelicans on Friday night in New Orleans.

games.headline: Luka Doncic scores 53 in another spectacular offensive game, carrying Lakers past Blazers 124-118
games.desc: — Luka Doncic scored 53 points and hit a key jumper in the lane with 28 seconds to play, carrying the Los Angeles Lakers to a 124-118 victory over the Portland Trail Blazers on Friday night.

games.headline: Wembanyama's 30 points, 14 rebounds power Spurs to a 124-109 win over the Kings
games.desc: — Victor Wembanyama had 30 points and 14 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs beat the Sacramento Kings 124-109 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night.
